title: Vintage Ashdale Pottery Stoneware Mug, Victorian Couple & Car, England
conditionDescription: Minor nick near the base stamp -- see photos. No cracks or chips to the rim or handle; glaze intact.
descriptionText:
Vintage Ashdale Pottery stoneware mug, made in England. Two-tone brown/olive transferware print wraps the mug: a Victorian-era couple (top hat, walking stick, parasol) on one side, an antique open-top motorcar on the other. Glossy brown glaze interior. Marked "PRODUCTS ASHDALE MADE IN ENGLAND" on the base.

Condition: minor nick near the base stamp -- see photos. No cracks or chips to the rim or handle.
